name: GL_BALANCE_INIT_HISTORY
description: This table stores the details from the balance initialization run, which creates opening balance journals in reporting currencies or secondary ledgers.

columns.name: RUN_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Code that indicates if the balance initialization process is being run for the first time or if it has already run. Valid values are INITIALIZE for a first run and RE-RUN for a rerun.

columns.name: SOURCE_LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Source ledger identifier for balance initialization run.

columns.name: TARGET_LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Target ledger identifier for balance initialization run.

columns.name: INITIALIZATION_PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Period in which balance initialization journals are created.

columns.name: INITIALIZATION_DATE
columns.description: Accounting date on which the balance initialization journals are created.

columns.name: TREE_VERSION_ID
columns.description: Tree version for the tree code associated with the primary balancing segment value in the source ledger.

columns.name: PRIMARY_BAL_SEG_VALUE
columns.description: Primary balancing segment value in the source ledger.

columns.name: SPLIT_BY_PRIMARY_BSV_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the balance initialization process was run with the Create Journal Batches by Primary Balancing Segment parameter selected.

columns.name: INITIALIZATION_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
